title: Flutter Developer Intern
description:
Flutter Developer Intern

**Company:** Infyx Infotech  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Internship  
**Position:** Flutter Developer Intern  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Work Mode:** On\-site

About Infyx Infotech

Infyx Infotech is a software development company delivering modern digital solutions including custom software, ERP systems, web and mobile applications, CRM, e\-commerce solutions, automation, and cloud\-based platforms.

We are looking for an enthusiastic **Flutter Developer Intern** who is passionate about mobile application development and eager to gain hands\-on experience working on real\-world projects.

Roles \& Responsibilities

* Develop mobile applications using **Flutter \& Dart**
* Build clean, responsive, and user\-friendly mobile interfaces
* Integrate **REST APIs** and backend services
* Work with JSON data and API responses
* Implement application navigation, forms, validations, and reusable components
* Handle state management using Provider, Riverpod, GetX, BLoC, or similar approaches
* Identify and fix bugs and performance issues
* Work with Git/GitHub for version control
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and senior developers
* Participate in testing, debugging, and application deployment
* Follow clean coding and development best practices

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**
* Understanding of mobile app development concepts
* Basic knowledge of **REST API integration**
* Familiarity with Android/iOS application development
* Understanding of responsive UI development
* Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub
* Good problem\-solving and logical thinking skills
* Willingness to learn new technologies

Good to Have

Knowledge or exposure to **Firebase, push notifications, Google Maps, payment gateway integration, local storage, authentication, and app publishing** will be an advantage.

Who Can Apply?

Students, recent graduates, and freshers from **BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, BSc IT, MSc IT, Computer Science, IT**, or related backgrounds can apply.

Candidates who have already developed academic, personal, or live Flutter projects will be preferred.

What You’ll Gain

You’ll get hands\-on experience working on **real\-world mobile applications**, API integrations, modern development practices, Git workflows, and complete application development cycles under the guidance of an experienced development team.

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
